The index (47 components, built 13 minutes ago from `AgentforceOrg`) shows one Account trigger, one Account flow, and no Account validation rules.

## Triggers
| Component | Events | Calls |
|---|---|---|
| `AccountTrigger` | before insert, before update | `AccountTriggerHandler` |

## Flows
| Flow | Type | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name` | Record-triggered, before save, on create and update | **Draft**, so it is not running |

The flow has no Apex actions and no subflows.

## Validation rules
None. A search of the index for Account validation rules returned zero results.

## Apex classes
| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `AccountTriggerHandler` | Trigger handler (`with sharing`) |
| `AccountService` | Business logic (`with sharing`) |
| `AccountSelector` | Query layer (`with sharing`) |
| `AccountTrigger_Test`, `AccountTriggerHandler_Test`, `AccountService_Test`, `AccountSelector_Test` | Tests |
| `RecordSelectorController` | Backs the `recordSelector` LWC. It uses generic `SObject`, so it isn't tied to Account in code. |

## Lightning component
`recordSelector` (LWC) is exposed on record, app and home pages. It imports `RecordSelectorController` and references `Account.Selected_Records__c` and `Case.Selected_Records__c`. It is the only component that references that field.

## Dependencies
```
AccountTrigger (before insert/update)
  └─ AccountTriggerHandler
       └─ AccountService
            └─ AccountSelector

recordSelector (LWC) ─ RecordSelectorController ─ (generic SObject)

Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name (Draft flow) ─ standalone
```
- The tests reference these classes:
  - `AccountTriggerHandler_Test` references `AccountTriggerHandler`.
  - `AccountService_Test` references `AccountService`.
  - `AccountSelector_Test` references `AccountSelector`.
  - `AccountTrigger_Test` references only `Name` and `Phone`, so it likely exercises the trigger through DML.
- Nothing else in the index calls `AccountService` or `AccountSelector`.

## Caveats
- The Account object itself isn't in the index, so I couldn't pull its fields, record types or other object-level metadata.
- The index may not have captured every metadata type. If you expect validation rules, I can check the org directly with a Tooling API query on `ValidationRule`.
- If the flow is activated, it and `AccountTrigger` would both run before save on Account. The flow's name append and the Apex logic could then interact. I haven't read the flow or handler source to see whether they touch the same fields.
